name: Chain Reaction
jem_summary: Ride a suspended chain and transfer to an adjoining compatible cable without touching the ground.

pages.title: Chain Reaction
pages.text: Ride a suspended chain and transfer to an adjoining compatible cable without touching the ground.

pages.title: Chain Reaction
pages.text: Extra chains and ropes let the player extend the cable route.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Connect supports with chains. Controls show the allowed attachment tool. Hold Use to attach and look toward travel; jump or release to detach. Shears change slack; punching a knot removes its attachment.
